title: Dustin Howes: the 15-step affiliate partnership process, from recruitment to repeat campaigns
summary: Dustin Howes walks through the 15 steps an affiliate takes from discovering a program to ranking content, earning sales and renegotiating terms. His core point is that this process takes time and only works if the manager actively holds the hand of high-potential affiliates and knows how long to spend on each step.

principles.text: Recruiting is a dance: affiliates either find your program or you find them, so you must actively recruit.
principles.quote: this is a dance you've got to get out there and recruit to help them find your program

principles.text: Entice affiliates to review and join with better commissions, landing pages and free products; it is not instant.
principles.quote: you might be enticing them with bigger commissions with landing pages with free products whatever it may be they have to review your product and your affiliate program and make sure it's a good fit for them

principles.text: Good affiliates do heavy keyword and content research, then replicate winning content and make it better.
principles.quote: they found a winner that they're gonna go after see what the kind some content is actually working and they're gonna have to replicate it and make it better

principles.text: Monetization takes time: affiliates usually promote multiple brands, so placement of your links in each piece matters.
principles.quote: they're probably promoting more than one brand at a time so monetization of each content piece is super important

principles.text: Watch reporting for up-and-coming affiliates who start bringing in sales, and connect with them to replicate success.
principles.quote: if you're doing all the right things with your reporting affiliate managers should be looking at their up-and-comers and connecting with the guys that are starting to bring in sales

principles.text: Negotiate as a give and take: they ask for the moon, you give a little, and you meet in the middle.
principles.quote: they're going to ask for the moon you're going to want to give them just a little bit and you guys got to meet in the middle somehow to make magic happen
